system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: project-info
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:cloudresourcemanager.projects.get
    properties:
      projectId: $(project.projectId)

  - name: enable-run-api
    type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:services.enable
    properties:
      name: projects/$(ref.project-info.projectNumber)/services/run.googleapis.com

  - name: enable-artifactregistry-api
    type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:services.enable
    properties:
      name: projects/$(ref.project-info.projectNumber)/services/artifactregistry.googleapis.com

  - name: enable-iamcredentials-api
    type: gcp-types/serviceusage-v1:services.enable
    properties:
      name: projects/$(ref.project-info.projectNumber)/services/iamcredentials.googleapis.com

  - name: github-actions-deployer-sa
    type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
    properties:
      name: projects/$(project.projectId)
      accountId: github-actions-deployer
      serviceAccount:
        displayName: GitHub Actions Deployer (WIF)

  - name: cloud-run-runtime-sa
    type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
    properties:
      name: projects/$(project.projectId)
      accountId: cloud-run-runtime
      serviceAccount:
        displayName: Cloud Run Runtime

  - name: github-wif-pool
    type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools
    properties:
      parent: projects/$(ref.project-info.projectNumber)/locations/global
      workloadIdentityPoolId: github-pool
      displayName: GitHub Actions Pool
      description: Workload Identity Pool for GitHub Actions OIDC

  - name: github-wif-provider
    type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools.providers
    properties:
      parent: $(ref.github-wif-pool.name)
      workloadIdentityPoolProviderId: github-oidc
      displayName: GitHub Actions OIDC Provider
      description: OIDC provider for token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      oidc:
        issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      attributeMapping:
        google.subject: assertion.sub
        attribute.repository: assertion.repository
        attribute.ref: assertion.ref
        attribute.actor: assertion.actor
        attribute.aud: assertion.aud
      attributeCondition: assertion.repository == 'OWNER/REPO' && assertion.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - github-wif-pool

  - name: bind-wif-to-deployer-sa
    type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: projects/$(project.projectId)/serviceAccounts/github-actions-deployer@$(project.projectId).iam.gserviceaccount.com
      role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
      member: principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/$(ref.github-wif-pool.name)/attribute.repository/OWNER/REPO
      condition:
        title: restrict-github-branch
        description: Allow from GitHub OIDC only for specific repo and branch
        expression: attribute.repository == 'OWNER/REPO' && attribute.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - github-actions-deployer-sa
        - github-wif-provider

  - name: project-iam-run-admin
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: projects/$(project.projectId)
      role: roles/run.admin
      member: serviceAccount:github-actions-deployer@$(project.projectId).iam.gserviceaccount.com
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - github-actions-deployer-sa
        - enable-run-api

  - name: project-iam-artifactregistry-writer
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: projects/$(project.projectId)
      role: roles/artifactregistry.writer
      member: serviceAccount:github-actions-deployer@$(project.projectId).iam.gserviceaccount.com
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - github-actions-deployer-sa
        - enable-artifactregistry-api

  - name: runtime-sa-impersonation-binding
    type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: projects/$(project.projectId)/serviceAccounts/cloud-run-runtime@$(project.projectId).iam.gserviceaccount.com
      role: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
      member: serviceAccount:github-actions-deployer@$(project.projectId).iam.gserviceaccount.com
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - cloud-run-runtime-sa
        - github-actions-deployer-sa
